claims.title: Load-safe recovery: retained metering, resonant release limits and own-side guides

quoted_fields.interface: A captured internal unit remains owned while a real retained support meters external reaction to actual free contact; same constant positive modal basis during the exact linear force ramp. Independent internal jam/hydraulic energy ownership. Own-side lateral guide in a single-column small-angle model must neither bridge an isolated cut nor bypass a sensor. Full dynamics, sensing, positive retention, force waveform and service/reset burdens are paid physical obligations.
quoted_fields.failure: Uniform force ramp and retained constant stiffness are necessary to the stated energy estimate; duration or monotonicity alone is insufficient. Restricted local positivity is not full buckling/6D stability. Low trigger force is not low released energy, and slow exterior release does not remove retained internal energy. Catalogue ratings are not this assembly, waveform, life or cost. Fixed-ledger waivers are arithmetic contracts rather than constructed services.
